The '''Country Lamp''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that provides light at night.  It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|500}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}.

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.
